description: Risk thresholds and governance controls. Each metric is turned into Low / Medium / High. See docs/taxonomy.md for the reasoning behind every number.

metrics.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.10 (privacy), 2.7 (security); NIST AI 600-1: Data Privacy, Information Security
controls: Document-level access control in retrieval: users only get documents they are cleared for
Output filter that blocks secrets and personal data (regex / NER) before the answer is shown
Remove credentials and personal contacts from the assistant's knowledge base

metrics.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5 (validity), 2.6 (safe failure beyond knowledge limits); NIST AI 600-1: Confabulation
controls: Grounding check: only answer when the retrieved documents support the answer
Show the source document with every answer
Standard fallback message that points to HR or the IT Service Desk

metrics.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5 (valid and reliable); NIST AI 600-1: Human-AI Configuration
controls: Pilot with a small user group before full rollout
Fix gaps in the knowledge base and re-test
Label answers as AI-generated and tell users to check important policy details with HR

metrics.risk: Over-refusal (assistant too cautious to be useful)
metrics.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5 (valid and reliable)
controls: Tune the safety prompt or filters so normal questions are answered; re-run the control set

unresolved_review.description: Answers the automatic checks could not judge (needs_label). Until a human labels them, the layer is at least Medium.

High.approval: Deployment blocked until the High risks are fixed and re-tested; exception only by the AI governance board / CISO

Medium.approval: System owner and Data Protection Officer sign off; required controls must be in place first
Medium.human_review: Human review of a sample of answers during the pilot

Low.human_review: Regular monitoring; re-test after every model or knowledge-base change
